name: The High Chieftain
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
narrative.objectives: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?!You have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again!Please accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 9, 1,095 XP in all.

quests.name: Longwalker Malah
quests.objectiveText: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.

quests.name: Grim Tidings
quests.objectiveText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Our Ancient Enemy
quests.objectiveText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.

quests.name: Drive Them Out
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.

quests.name: The High Chieftain
quests.objectiveText: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
